headline.statement: FD4 has no cleanly individually resolved connectome correlate in FlyWire v783; it shares FD1's entire progressive, heterolateral, cholinergic, noduli-group output class, and no separable FD4 cell or Nod1 sub-pair exists.

v630.reason: v630 recompute unavailable (empty RF cloud on v630 for one Nod1 cell)

claims.claim: FD4 shares FD1's progressive, heterolateral, cholinergic, noduli-group output class
claims.notes: Egelhaaf p.204-206: FD4 is progressive like FD1 and uses the FD1nod/FD3 noduli-group axon

claims.claim: No progressive figure-output cell exists in the connectome besides Nod1 (= FD1)
claims.measured: 28 layer-a low-copy types screened over 8806; sole survivor = ['Nod1']
claims.notes: Every other layer-a heterolateral cell is GABA/glutamate/dopamine feedback or centrifugal

claims.claim: The 4-cell Nod1 type pools two same-side cells per hemisphere (Egelhaaf FD1nod + FD1pof)
claims.notes: High same-side / low cross-side partner overlap = two copies of one cell type per side

claims.claim: The 4 Nod1 cells are one homogeneous frontal population, not a separable FD1 + FD4 split
claims.measured: both bilateral pairings have negative silhouette (best -4.926); separable=False
claims.notes: No pairing separates the cells; none carries the FD4 whole-eye lateral receptive field

claims.claim: FD3 = LPT42_Nod4 is not FD4 despite its FD4-shaped absolute receptive field
claims.notes: Direction excludes LPT42_Nod4 from FD4; FD4 also has no frontal gap, which LPT42_Nod4 has

claims.claim: FD4 property: heterolateral noduli-group axon (contra POF)

claims.notes: FD4-discriminating property; not realized by the Nod1 population

claims.claim: FD4 property: whole-eye, laterally-weighted RF (no frontal gap)
claims.measured: no lateral sub-pair; the population RF is frontal (FD1-like)
claims.notes: FD4-discriminating property; not realized by the Nod1 population

claims.measured: all Nod1 cells span the full dorso-ventral extent
claims.notes: FD4-discriminating property; not realized by the Nod1 population

claims.claim: FD4 property: no lateral-protocerebrum second arbor
The connectomic identity of Egelhaaf FD4 in FlyWire v783
claims.notes: FD4 shares FD1's entire progressive, heterolateral, cholinergic, noduli-group output class, so it cannot be separated from FD1 by direction, transmitter, or output side. It is distinguished only by a whole-eye laterally-weighted receptive field and a restricted dorso-ventral dendrite. No separable FD4 sub-pair was found: the four Nod1 cells are one homogeneous frontal population (Nod1 = FD1, likely pooling Egelhaaf's FD1nod and FD1pof variants), and no other progressive figure-output cell exists. FD4 is therefore not individually resolved in FlyWire v783. Point estimate 0.0, plausible range [0.0, 0.27], verdict UNRESOLVED_HONEST_NULL. No cell or Nod1 sub-pair carries the FD4-discriminating receptive-field and dendrite signature; FD4 is not individually resolved. Point 0.0, range [0.0, 0.27].

claims.claim: Decomposed confidence that FD4 is individually resolved (with the Nod1 population)
claims.notes: Discounted for FD1-collinearity (shared output class), no distinct FlyWire type, no independent anchor, and the literature's declined FD1/2/3/4 mapping
